description:

DriveTime Family of Brands is the largest privately owned used car sales finance & servicing company in the nation. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona and Dallas, Texas, we create opportunities and improve the lives of our customers and our employees by placing a focus on putting the right customer, in the right vehicle, on the right terms and on their path to ownership.
The DriveTime Family of Brands spans across DriveTime , Bridgecrest and SilverRock. You can find us at the intersection of technology and innovation as we use our proprietary tools and over two decades of industry knowledge to redefine the process of purchasing, financing, and protecting your vehicle.
That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?
This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time.
In short, you’ll join our Evolve engineering team as a Senior Software Engineer, helping modernize critical legacy green‑screen applications running on IBM i / DB2 into reliable, cloud‑hosted systems. This role blends deep technical execution with collaboration, as you work across engineering, product, and business partners to rebuild accounting, cashiering, and operational workflows using modern full‑stack, event‑driven architectures.
In long, as the Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:

• Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable full‑stack applications using Angular and .NET

• Creating Angular‑based single‑page applications with strong attention to usability and performance

• Contributing to event‑driven and workflow‑oriented solutions, including asynchronous processing, reconciliation, and backfill scenarios

• Ensuring applications meet security, performance, and compliance expectations

• Participating in code reviews and mentoring junior engineers to support team growth and continuous improvement

So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking For?

• Engineers who enjoy modernizing complex, legacy systems and aren’t intimidated by untangling decades‑old processes

• Strong collaborators who can communicate technical concepts clearly to non‑technical stakeholders

• Problem solvers who take ownership and think critically about long‑term maintainability

• Team players who value clean code, testing, and thoughtful design

• People who are curious, adaptable, and open to evolving engineering practices

• Engineers comfortable using AI‑assisted development tools responsibly, with a strong human‑in‑the‑loop mindset

The Specifics.

• 5+ years of full‑stack development experience with C# and .NET

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience

• Hands‑on experience building scalable, distributed systems

• Strong experience developing APIs using RESTful and/or GraphQL approaches

• Solid Angular experience for front‑end development

• Experience designing and working with event‑driven architectures

• Strong knowledge of SQL Server, including complex queries and stored procedures

• Proficiency with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript

• Experience writing unit tests and supporting high‑quality, maintainable codebases

• Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation

title: Product Line Manager
description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity-driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.
As a member of Ciena ’s Interconnects Product Line Management team, this role shapes the strategy, commercialization, and lifecycle execution of high-speed optical and electrical interconnect technologies used in and around the data center. The position serves as the primary product management interface with Ciena ’s technology partners while influencing how interconnect solutions are delivered across evolving customer consumption models. This role combines interconnect domain expertise with cross-functional leadership to drive market adoption and business outcomes.
How you will make an impact:

• Define product strategy and multi-year roadmaps for optical and electrical interconnect technologies including co-packaged optics, near-packaged optics, advanced optical packaging, and electrical interconnects

• Lead commercialization efforts for optical and electrical interfaces, associated technologies, and in-house components

• Establish commercial offers and pricing structures aligned with industry norms

• Develop business cases and secure approvals for new features and initiatives

• Partner with marketing teams to create product positioning and customer-facing materials including presentations, data sheets, and competitive analyses

• Serve as a primary interface between engineering, sales, customers, and external technology partners

• Assess customer requirements, technology trends, regulatory considerations, and competitive dynamics to guide roadmap decisions

The must haves:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering

• Experience: 10+ years of technical experience in telecommunications or the component industry

• Application of high-speed interconnect technologies including co-packaged optics, near-packaged optics, active electrical and copper cables, coherent, direct detect, SerDes, PHYs, and electro-optics

• Background in optical and electrical interconnect architectures and emerging component standards

• Utilization of component commercialization models including modules, bare die, and chiplets

• Experience defining commercialization requirements such as SDKs, documentation, and sales enablement frameworks

• Background working with cross-functional modem, component, and R&D teams to define and prioritize features and roadmaps

• Ability to gather and translate customer and internal stakeholder requirements into product specifications and proposals, including responses to RFIs and RFPs

• Clear communication and presentation skills across technical and non-technical audiences

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives with minimal direction in a virtual or cross-functional environment

Nice to haves:

• Experience with direct detect and coherent optical technologies

• Background interfacing directly with external technology partners

• Prior experience in product management, solutions architecture, technical marketing, FAE, or sales engineering roles

• Experience influencing component or subsystem product strategies across multiple market consumption models

• Exposure to global customer engagements, trade shows, or industry forums

• Willingness to travel approximately 20%, including international travel

Pay Range:
The annual pay range for this position is $114,100 - $182,300.
The annual pay range for this position in California is $158,500 - $253,300.

Do you get excited about crafting high-converting AI-powered content that stop the scroll, hook viewers in the first 3 seconds, and drive real results all without needing a founder in front of the camera? Do you like to edit ads for funnels that will reach millions and change people's lives?
My name is Richard, and I'm the founder/CEO of Impact Clients .
You can find me here on Instagram:
I also have a YouTube channel with over 100K subscribers:
With all of my social media platforms, my ultimate goal is simple: serve others, love God, and love people. As our company continues to expand and empower everyday people with the mindset, skillset, and strategies to earn a high income online, we're looking for committed, high-level creative talent to join our team for the long haul.
Right now, we're searching for a full-time AI Ads Video Editor to produce high-performing paid ads built around AI avatars, AI voiceovers, and creative formats that don't require founder involvement to film. If you live and breathe AI tools and you know how to turn them into ads that actually convert this role is for you.
Tasks
Create AI-driven paid ads from concept to final cut - including AI avatars, AI voiceovers, AI b-roll, and motion graphics

• Produce ads in the style we already run for Impact Clients (you'll be expected to study and match our existing ad library)

• Innovate in editing styles by looking at what competitors do

• Be strong at editing attention grabbing hooks that keeps viewers watching until the CTA

• Work in volume and quality, being able to edit ads that will be launched at scale and will perofrm

• Collaborate with our copywriters to turn high quality copy into high quality ads

• Stay on top of the latest AI tools (HeyGen, Synthesia, ElevenLabs, Runway, Sora, Kling, Midjourney, etc.) and bring new creative formats to the team

• Use insights from copywriters and winning ads to improve the next round of creatives

• As a bonus: brainstorm and collaborate on ad angles, scripts, and concepts that maximize ROAS

Requirements
Application requirements:

• You must send your Ads/AI content portfolio

• You must record a 5-min loom video of presentation

If both of the above requirements aren't met, you will not be considered for a position.
Tools You Should Master

• AI video editing tools: Higgsfield, HeyGen, Synthesia, Captions AI, or equivalent

• AI voice tools: ElevenLabs, or equivalent

• AI video/image generation: Nano-banana, Runway, Sora, Kling, Midjourney, etc.

• Premiere Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve (must be highly proficient in at least one)

• After Effects for advanced graphic animations

Who this role is not for

• If you've never edited paid ads before or don't understand direct-response creative

• If you're not deeply familiar with AI editing tools and AI avatars

• If you're uncomfortable with faith-based Christian content/refuse to edit Christian content if absolutely necessary (this won't be a key part of the role/ads don't have a lot of christian edits)

• If you can't commit to and hold deadlines

• If you're unable to communicate properly on deadlines/manage expectations on the delivery of your work

Who This Role IS For

• You're obsessed with AI tools and constantly testing what's new

• You want to be part of a fast-growing team with long-term opportunities

• Top editors get performance bonuses

• Top team members get offered promotions (i.e. become a lead editor)

• Top team members can grow into other roles if they have the aptitude for it (i.e. copywriting)

• You understand what makes a paid ad convert, not just look pretty

• You want creative ownership while still collaborating with a high-performance team

• You have a srong understanding of paid ad structure: hooks, pacing, captions, CTAs, and direct-response storytelling

• Bonuses:

• You have experience with FB/Tiktok/IG editing and long-form Youtube editing

• You have written ads/have been a copywriter in the past

• You have edited AI ads

title: Cybersecurity ISSE (Principal)
Head of IT
description:
About Centerbase At Centerbase , we empower mid-size law firms to run their practices more efficiently, profitably, and client-centrically. Our cloud-based legal practice management platform streamlines the entire client lifecycle from intake to billing to business intelligence, helping attorneys deliver exceptional service while achieving their growth goals. We’re more than just a software provider-we’re a partner in transformation. With a focus on automation, flexibility, and continuous innovation, we give firms the tools to modernize operations, improve collaboration, and adapt to the evolving expectations of today’s clients and legal professionals. At Centerbase , we come to work every day committed to making legal work easier, smarter, and more impactful for the firms and communities we serve. Everything we do is guided by four core values:

• Customer Centric

• Stronger Together

• Be the Difference

• Relentless Improvement

These values shape who we are: a dedicated, inventive, and passionate team committed to empowering law firms to achieve lasting growth and success.

Summary

Centerbase is seeking a hands-on Director, Cloud & IT Operations to lead the operational backbone of our cloud-driven business through an active migration and beyond. Reporting to the CTO, you'll own the day-to-day across our cloud environment - as we consolidate onto AWS from a mix of Azure and colocation - plus our internal IT and corporate systems and the execution of our security and compliance programs, keeping Centerbase secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient as we grow.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll land the cloud migration and stand up modern operations - DevOps, observability, incident response, and cost discipline - while leading a lean team of employees and specialized service partners. You'll bring an AI-forward mindset to force-multiply a small team, and you'll know when to build in-house versus leverage providers.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Operations - Land the Migration & Own It · the priority

• Land the in-flight consolidation onto AWS (from Azure and colocation), then run best-practice cloud operations: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and release/change management.

• Build observability and performance monitoring - metrics, logging, tracing, and SLOs/SLIs - and drive down alert noise and mean-time-to-resolution.

• Own the production incident and issue-resolution process: severity levels, on-call, runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

• Ensure reliability and resilience - high availability, backup, disaster recovery (RPO/RTO), and regular DR testing.

• Partner with Engineering and DevOps on operational readiness and the platform-vs-product infrastructure boundary.

• Bring an AI-forward approach to operations - use automation and AI to force-multiply a lean team across monitoring, runbooks, incident response, and cost analysis.

Cloud Cost Management (FinOps)

• Own a growing cloud spend: cost visibility and tagging, rightsizing, commitments (Savings Plans / Reserved Instances), budgets, and anomaly detection - keeping the migration cost-disciplined.

• Drive continuous cost optimization and cost accountability across teams.

• Rationalize the SaaS and tooling portfolio (including AI tools) - consolidate overlapping tools and renegotiate vendors.

Internal IT & Corporate Technology

• Own the internal IT ecosystem - networks, endpoints, productivity tools, and identity management.

• Run onboarding/offboarding, role-based access controls, and device lifecycle management.

• Manage third-party SaaS systems and integrations; drive automation and a strong employee-IT experience.

• Oversee help desk operations with a customer-centric service culture and clear SLAs.

Security, Risk & Compliance - Execution

• Execute and mature the compliance program - SOC 2 today, with HIPAA being added to this year's audit, alongside NIST and GDPR/California privacy - in partnership with the CTO and our security par

title: Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values-Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable-and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role
As Senior Insider & Data Risk Analyst, you will own insider risk investigations and help mature Alpaca 's Insider Risk Management Program and Data Loss Prevention capabilities. You will triage and investigate signals across people, devices, identity, and data movement, apply risk tiering and escalation standards, and partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, and IT on sensitive cases involving departures, policy violations, and data misuse.
This role sits at the intersection of insider risk, data protection, privacy, and financial services. Reporting to the Cyber GRC Lead, you will serve as Security's escalation point for insider and data loss cases affecting trading systems, customer data, and proprietary information. This is a practical senior individual contributor role for someone experienced, discreet, and highly organized who can own investigation workflows, translate risk into clear language for leadership, and build durable programs and processes. Prior experience in a regulated or financial services environment is a strong plus.
Things You Get To Do

• Own insider risk investigations from triage through closure, including case timelines, containment, escalation, and documented determinations and lessons learned

• Mature Alpaca 's Insider Risk Management Program, including case management processes, risk tiering, and repeatable workflows

• Operate and tune Data Loss Prevention tooling across multiple environments and endpoints, refining rulesets to improve signal and reduce false positives

• Mature data classification and align DLP controls to sensitivity levels

• Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, and policy violations; build and tune detections and monitoring

• Investigate misuse and exfiltration risk across source code, Google, AWS, Azure, third party apps, Slack, and trading and platform system access

• Partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, and IT on sensitive cases (departures, policy violations, data mishandling) with discretion and care

• Assess risk from unauthorized AI/agentic tooling and sensitive data exposure through approved and unsanctioned AI tooling

• Leverage Agentic AI to continue maturation of Insider risk program

• Lead insider and data risk assessments and maintain risk registers

• Support internal and external audits and regulatory requirements

title: Nurse Practitioner - National After-Hours Team - part time - IA and MO or OH Lic

As a national leader in value-based care, we offer senior living communities and skilled nursing facilities a wide range of solutions (including on-site primary care services, Accountable Care Organizations, and Medicare Advantage Special Needs Plans) proven to enhance health outcomes, streamline operations, and create new financial opportunities.
Founded in 2021, we've grown quickly-now serving 200,000+ seniors in 1,500+ communities across 32 states. Our team includes more than 1,000 clinicians alongside care coordinators, analysts, operators, and professionals from all backgrounds, all working together to deliver high-quality, proactive solutions for senior living operators and those they care for.
Ranked #147 on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies, we're just getting started. If you're looking to make a meaningful impact on the senior healthcare landscape, you're in the right place-and we look forward to working with you.
For more information about our company, visit CuranaHealth.com.
Summary
At Curana Health , we are committed to supporting the health, dignity, and comfort of residents in senior living communities. Our National After-Hours Call Team plays a vital role by providing compassionate telephonic care and clinical direction during evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays-ensuring that residents receive timely, high-quality support without unnecessary transfers.
In this work-from-home role, you’ll deliver after-hours care virtually (primarily by phone) to aging residents across multiple states. This position offers both autonomy and purpose-you’ll be the trusted voice and clinical partner helping residents and facility staff during critical times, making an immediate impact in the lives of older adults.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Serve as the first line of support for residents and facility staff after-hours, providing direction and medical care over the phone.

• Use Curana’s telephonic platform to take and place calls, coordinating care between facilities, hospitals, and clinics.

• Deliver high-quality, cost-effective care to patients-addressing acute, chronic, and behavioral health needs in collaboration with physicians and specialty providers.

• Perform comprehensive assessments and document encounters accurately and thoroughly in the EMR, ensuring compliance with CMS requirements.

• Apply Curana’s clinical protocols and practice guidelines to support safe, effective treatment in place whenever possible.

• Participate in mandatory education and training to stay current with standards of care.

Scheduling & Hours:
While shift times can vary, we provide coverage to skilled nursing and senior living facilities on weeknights from 5pm- 8am local time, continuous coverage from Friday at 5pm to Monday at 8am. Holiday coverage is also provided beginning at 5pm of the end of the last business day to 8am of the resumption of business hours.

• Overnight and holidays are required for all After Hours Call Team Members

• Two 12 hour holiday shifts per year required. Holiday scheduling is completed at the beginning of the year for advanced planning

Education and Experience:

• Nurse Practitioner national certification as ANP, FNP, or GNP

• Ability to obtain DEA licensure / Prescriptive Authority

title: Associate Account Executive, New York City
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for startups. Open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About the Role

As an Associate Account Executive at Rho, you will play a pivotal role in our sales team, focusing on lead generation, sales support, and client engagement. This position is designed to be a launching pad for your career in fintech and software sales, offering a clear path to becoming a full Account Executive within a year.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of Rho's growth initiatives, working closely with Senior Account Executives to drive new business and support existing client relationships. You'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in the dynamic world of fintech, gaining hands-on experience with our innovative all-in-one financial platform that combines corporate cards, payments, and banking services.

Your responsibilities will span a range of critical sales activities, from conducting outreach through phone, email, and in-person interactions to attending industry events and meeting potential clients. This position will challenge you to develop a deep understanding of Rho's value proposition and articulate it effectively to prospects across various industries.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct lead-generation activities through phone, email, and in-person interactions.

- Provide sales assistance and deal support to senior Account Executives

- Attend industry events and meet with potential clients to build relationships

- Learn and articulate Rho's value proposition to prospects

- Maintain accurate records in our CRM system

- Collaborate with marketing and product teams to stay updated on new features and promotions.

- Contribute to the development of sales strategies and tactics.

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

- Strong organizational and time management abilities.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

- Passion for fintech and willingness to learn about financial products and services

Our people are our most valuable asset. The base salary for this role is $70,500. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, healthcare benefits and paid time off. This role is eligible for an uncapped performance bonus paid quarterly. Inclusive of on-target performance bonuses, the total salary range for this role is $90,500.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. title: Directeur, Croissance et innovation
description:
Description de poste
Le Directeur Croissance et Innovation joue un rôle central dans l’évolution stratégique du portefeuille de solutions logicielles de l’entreprise dans le secteur de la santé. En étroite collaboration avec le Vice‑Président R&D et le comité exécutif, il définit, orchestre et exécute la stratégie produit afin de soutenir la croissance, moderniser les plateformes et accélérer la transition vers un modèle SaaS.
À la tête d’une équipe de gestionnaires de produit, il inspire, mobilise et encadre les équipes responsables de la stratégie produit, en s’assurant que chaque initiative est alignée avec les priorités d’affaires, les besoins des clients et les orientations technologiques de l’entreprise.
Son leadership contribue directement à l’innovation, la performance organisationnelle et l’impact des solutions dans le réseau de la santé au Québec , en positionnant l’entreprise comme un acteur incontournable de la transformation numérique du secteur.
Le rôle comporte deux dimensions déterminantes. D’une part, le titulaire conduit la transformation agentique de l’organisation produit : il redéfinit les façons de travailler de son équipe en déléguant à des agents d’IA les activités de coordination, de suivi et d’analyse, afin de concentrer le temps de ses gestionnaires sur le jugement et la décision. D’autre part, il assume un volet développement des affaires : présence directe auprès des clients du réseau de la santé, développement de partenariats stratégiques et contribution formelle à la qualification du pipeline de croissance, en co-imputabilité avec les équipes de vente.
Responsabilités principales

•
Leadership stratégique :

• Définir et porter les strategies de croissance et d’innovation pour l’ensemble du portefeuille de produits logiciels dans le secteur de la santé.

• Diriger et inspirer une équipe de gestionnaires de produit en favorisant une culture axée sur l’impact, l’innovation et l’exécution.

•
Stratégie produit et transformation numérique :

• Élaborer et maintenir la feuille de route stratégique des produits, incluant la migration vers un modèle SaaS moderne, scalable et sécuritaire.

• Aligner les initiatives produit avec les objectifs du comité exécutif et les orientations technologiques de l’entreprise.

•
Transformation agentique de l’organisation produit :

• Concevoir et piloter la transformation des façons de travailler de l’organisation produit par l’IA agentique : coordination de portefeuille, suivi d’avancement, production des états d’avancement, veille et analyse de marché.

• Déterminer, pour chaque rôle de l’équipe produit, ce qui peut être délégué à des agents et ce qui doit demeurer sous imputabilité humaine, puis redéfinir les rôles et les compétences en conséquence.

• Établir les garde-fous d’un usage responsable de l’IA - qualité, traçabilité, protection des renseignements de santé - mesurer les gains de capacité obtenus et en rendre compte à la direction.

•
Gestion de portefeuille et gouvernance de l’exécution :

• Superviser la priorisation des initiatives et la cohérence du portefeuille, en s’appuyant sur des mécanismes de suivi outillés et automatisés plutôt que sur de la coordination manuelle.

• Répondre de l’avancement des initiatives stratégiques - échéanciers, budgets et objectifs d’affaires - au moyen d’indicateurs et de tableaux de bord alimentés automatiquement.

•
Développement des affaires et relation client :

• Entretenir un contact direct et régulier avec les clients du réseau de la santé et porter la relation avec les partenaires stratégiques de l’écosystème.

• Contribuer formellement au pipeline de croissance : détection, qualification et priorisation des opportunités liées au portefeuille, en co-imputabilité avec les équipes de vente.

• Traduire la valeur des solutions en propositions monétisables : modèles de tarification, offres de migration SaaS et ententes de partenariat.

title: BC, 2D Senior Compositor - Expression of Interest
description:
2D Senior Compositor - Expression of Interest
This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter.
This position is based in Vancouver. All applicants MUST reside in British Columbia, Canada.
About Zoic
Zoic Studios is a Visual Effects company that specializes in high end visual effects for television, film, and advertising. Our mantra is Visual Evolution - we focus on every part of the process, from the final picture to the pipeline used to create them.
Are you looking for your next creative and technical challenge? Come join our team!
Why Join Zoic?

• We are an Artist owned and operated VFX studio.

• We love what we do and always stay curious about new technology and techniques.

• We respect work/life balance in a hectic industry.

• We work with a team from all walks of life and backgrounds.

Position Overview
Our Vancouver, BC location is interested in hearing from VFX Coordinators for future openings.
The Nuke compositors will have strong shot finishing skills for a variety of episodic streaming projects across different services. The ideal candidate will be highly skilled using Nuke within a production pipeline with strong CG integration capabilities.
Must be able to collaborate well within a small team and be comfortable in a fast-paced environment. Compositors will take direction from the VFX and Compositing Supervisors.
Responsibilities:

• Integrate multiple layers and/or elements into live action shots.

• Perform all tasks associated with the compositing process, including 2D tracking, matte extraction, 2.5D camera projection, layering of elements, Nuke 3D workflow and color grading on moderately difficult to difficult shots.

• Maintain the overall look, quality and color balance for all assigned shots and/or sequences.

• Maintain clean and efficient script organization.

• Work within the pipeline of the show/company.

• Ability to work collaboratively with supervisors and other artists from other disciplines.

• Strong knowledge of Nuke Compositing and experience with medium and large scale productions a plus.

• Eye for color and composition.

• Ability to take artistic direction and not afraid to ask questions or gain clarity.

• Address internal/external notes from supervisors and clients.

• Work with Production to ensure internal and external deadlines and deliveries are met within assigned hours.

• Attend dailies and other meetings as required.

Qualifications:

• Proficient in Nuke

• Knowledge of projection, 2.5D camera projection, matte painting integration, CG integration, Nuke 3D workflow, EXR integration, rig removal

• Knowledge and experience in 3D multi-pass rendering techniques and color space concepts

• Working knowledge of Maya, Houdini and/or Unreal a plus

• Expert eye for color and composition

• Ability to take artistic direction and take shots to final.

• Works well with tight deadlines

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English)

• Highly organized

• Problem solving capabilities with a “solution-driven” attitude.

• Strong attention to detail and follow through.

• Experience in fast-paced environment

• Past experience mentoring junior artists.

Bonus points

• Python/scripting experience.

• Familiarity using Shotgun/Shotgrid.

Additional information

• British Columbia Senior Employees Pay Range: $50 - $65 (The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location of the position)

title: Experienced Vulnerability Researcher
description:
We’re always on the lookout for experienced and passionate vulnerability researchers to join our team. If you have a background in offensive security and think collaborating on high-impact challenges with some of the best in the industry sounds like fun, we’d love to hear from you. No formal education or certifications required.
The team:

Vulnerability Research and Exploit Development (VRED) take curiosity, perseverance and exceptional teamwork. You’ll join one of our established platform teams to focus on your preferred target set, backed globally by the entire VRED team. Our platform teams include Android, iOS, Browsers, Hypervisors and Embedded Systems.

The role:

• You will conduct vulnerability research using a range of approaches and techniques.

• You will develop proof-of-concept exploits for vulnerabilities found, which includes bypassing modern exploit mitigations.

• Our researchers know and learn what they need for their work. You will have access to the tools and infrastructure you need to do your best.

• You will contribute to a collaborative and supportive culture, sharing knowledge and findings with others in a helpful and accessible way.

• You will have the opportunity to participate in and run workshops and other team activities.

The ideal candidate:

• Experience in one or more of vulnerability research, reverse engineering and exploit development.

• Interested in and passionate about learning new things, taking things apart, and get stuck into new problems and challenges.

• Able to work both independently and highly collaboratively.

• A permanent resident and currently based in Australia.

Salary:

Packages are competitive and differ according to researcher experience. Full details can be discussed upon an invitation to interview.

Perks and benefits:

• 25 days annual leave + public holidays

• Annual bonus based on company targets

• Minimum of 12% superannuation

• Training and conference budgets

• Employee assistance program

• Company socials throughout the year

The location:

This is a remote role. The team meets up in-person for workshops, conferences, and socials, so occasional travel will be required.

Interrupt Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

We aim to respond to all candidates via email within two weeks of their application. Please note that emails may go to your spam or junk folder.

title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
Behind every business that runs like clockwork, there is one person quietly winding the clock.
Job Overview
Our UK-based client needs a full-time, remote Administrative Coordinator - an organised, dependable South African professional who keeps projects, paperwork and people moving in the right direction. This is a long-term role working UK business hours, with real responsibility from week one.
About Our Client
The client is a busy UK company where operations move quickly and details matter. They are not looking for someone to simply process tasks; they want a coordinator who spots what is missing, chases what is late, and builds small systems that stop problems repeating.
Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate schedules, meetings and deadlines across multiple teams

• Prepare, format and proofread documents, reports and presentations

• Maintain accurate records, trackers and filing systems

• Chase outstanding actions and keep task lists honest and current

• Handle supplier queries, orders and administrative correspondence

• Support managers with travel bookings, expenses and ad-hoc requests

• Improve small processes so the same problem never lands twice

What You Will Be Doing Day-to-Day
Mornings start with the trackers: what is due, what is overdue, and who needs a nudge. You will confirm the day's meetings, prepare any documents needed, and clear the administrative inbox before it builds up.
Through the day you will move between coordination and execution - updating records, formatting reports, logging supplier responses, and keeping every plate spinning without drama. You will close each day with tomorrow already half-organised.
This role suits a South African professional who likes order, notices details other people miss, and gets quiet satisfaction from a plan that actually happens. You will work independently, but never alone - the team communicates constantly and values people who speak up early.
If you are based in South Africa with excellent English and a track record of keeping busy teams organised, this is a stable, long-term remote role with a UK employer that will trust you with real responsibility. Apply now and bring the clockwork.
Requirements

• 3+ years' experience in administration, coordination or office support

• Excellent written and spoken English with a confident, professional manner

• Proven reliability: stable fibre internet, backup power for load shedding, and a dedicated home office

• Strong command of tech tools: Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, spreadsheets, and shared task trackers

• Exceptional attention to detail with disciplined follow-through

• Comfortable juggling multiple priorities to UK business hours without dropping any

Benefits
Full-time remote position working for a UK-based employer. Competitive salary paid in ZAR. Long-term stable role. Supportive team environment. Direct access to founder-led business.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.
This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

• Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.

• Strong English C1+ - instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.

Langfristige Perspektive: Bei gegenseitigem Interesse entwickeln wir Ihre Rolle weiter - mit wachsender Verantwortung und spannenden Projekten.

About the role
We're hiring an AI Senior SRE: someone who carries a normal SRE workload - on-call rotation, incident response, root cause analysis, hands-on Kubernetes/cloud work - and builds the agentic layer that automates that workload over time. You are not exempt from operating production. You're the person best placed to know what should be automated, because you're the one doing it. This role exists because most reliability toil (triage, root-causing, remediation, SLO tracking, onboarding checks) is repetitive and well-defined enough to hand to an LLM-based agent with the right guardrails. Your job is to do the on-call/ops work like any SRE, then turn what you learn into agents - identify the workflow, build the agent, and earn the trust to let it act with increasing autonomy.
What you'll do

• Carry a normal on-call rotation and act as a hands-on responder: investigate, fix, and document incidents yourself, exactly like any SRE on the team - especially for workflows that don' t have an agent yet.

• Go deep on application-level reliability, not just infrastructure: read and debug service code, understand business logic well enough to find the real root cause, and ship fixes or PRs directly into application repos when the fix belongs in the app, not the platform.

• Design, build, and ship LLM-based agents (using tools like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3) that plug into our existing stack: Kubernetes, cloud APIs, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Datadog, PagerDuty/Slack.

• Define the "tool" interface each agent needs - the specific APIs, scripts, and read/write actions - and build safe wrappers around them.

• Set clear guardrails for every agent: what it may do autonomously vs. what it must propose for human approval, with a bias toward human-in-the-loop until an agent has earned trust.

• Own agent evaluation - define what "correct" and "safe" look like per agent, and build test/backtest suites against real historical incidents.

• Continuously tune prompts, context, and tool schemas as an agent' s scope grows.

• Partner with the SRE/platform team to find good agent candidates: repetitive, well-scoped, auditable workflows.

• Report on agent impact - MTTD/MTTR/MTTX movement, false positive/negative rates, and engineer-hours of toil removed.

• Keep a security- and compliance-first posture: audit trails for every autonomous action, least-privilege access to production, and alignment with Saudi data residency/regulatory requirements.

Requirements

• 3+ years building production software with LLMs - agentic workflows, tool/function calling, multi-step planning, RAG - not just personal use of a chat assistant.

• Hands-on experience shipping real work with an agentic coding tool such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3.

• Strong Python (or similar) for building agent tooling, API wrappers, and orchestration.

• Real, hands-on SRE experience: comfortable being a primary on-call responder, running incident response, and doing root cause analysis under pressure - not just familiar with the concepts.

• Application-level debugging skill, not just infra: able to read a service' s codebase, trace a failure back to the actual line/logic causing it, and ship a fix yourself - SRE work here isn' t limited to restarting pods or scal

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for our first hospitality fan Sales person in Munich. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

- Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

- Create engaging ways to show our product

- Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

- Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

- Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

- Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

- Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

- Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

- Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

- Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

- Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

- A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

- You are comfortable working in both English and German

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary & Uncapped Commission

- Flexible time off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
About Influur

Influur is reimagining how advertising works - through creators, data, and AI. Our mission is to make influencer marketing as measurable, predictable, and scalable as paid media - and we're building the tech that makes it possible. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by global brands, we're scaling fast across music, culture, and entertainment.

We're looking for an FP&A Analyst who's excited to build real financial modeling skills inside a fast-growing, AI-native finance team.

The Role

You'll work directly with the FP&A Lead, supporting budget tracking, financial modeling, and forecasting across Influur 's business lines. This is not a data-entry role - it's a seat where you'll learn real FP&A from the ground up: how to build models the right way, how to read what the numbers are actually saying, and how to turn that into decisions leadership can act on.

We're looking for someone who already has real modeling fundamentals - we're not here to teach the basics of a formula or what a balance sheet is. What we will teach is how to apply that foundation to budgeting, contingency planning, rebudget cycles, and investor-grade reporting. If you have the base and the hunger to grow into it, this is your seat.

Your Skillset:

Must-haves:

• 1-2 years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, financial consulting, or a closely related analytical role

• Real, demonstrable financial modeling fundamentals - you know how to build a model from scratch, with clean structure and documented assumptions, not just fill in a template

• Advanced (Intermediate) Excel / Google Sheets - formulas, structuring data, comfortable without a template

• Understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and how the three financial statements connect

• Strong attention to detail - you catch inconsistencies in data before they become errors

• English proficiency, B2 or above (written, spoken, and reading)

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or related field
Nice-to-haves:

• Exposure to multi-business-unit or multi-entity P&L environments

• Curiosity about AI tools applied to finance - you don't need to be an expert, but you're already experimenting

• Experience supporting investor reporting or board-level materials

• Startup or high-growth company experience

You're the Type Who:

• Has real modeling bases, but doesn't pretend to know everything - you want to be trained, and you're hungry to learn

• Takes ownership without being asked twice

• Is genuinely curious about AI - you already use it, even if you're not an expert, and you want to get better

• Pays obsessive attention to detail - a wrong formula or a mislabeled row bothers you until it's fixed

• Is comfortable with ambiguity - startups don't hand you a finished playbook

• Has a startup mindset: speed, resourcefulness, and comfort wearing more than one hat

First 90 days:

• Fully ramped on Influur 's financial structure, reporting cadence, and modeling standards

• Owns the monthly budget-vs-actuals tracking process independently

• Has contributed to at least one full rebudget cycle

• Shows growing fluency applying AI tools to real reporting and modeling workflows

What we offer:

• Remote work

• Direct mentorship from the FP&A Lead and CFO, with a clear growth path

• Real ownership from day one - your models inform board and investor decisions

• Opportunity to build modern, AI-assisted FP&A skills inside a real finance function

• A collaborative, high-ownership team environmen

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Important: For this position, it is essential that you have a good command of the Dutch language, both written and spoken.

Start jouw carrière als Campaign Operations Specialist in Eindhoven!
Wil jij starten als Campaign Operations Speciailst in Eindhoven en werken met data, AI en digitale campagnes? Bij WPP Media krijg je als starter de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen SEO, SEA, Social en Programmatic advertising en werken we samen met topmerken zoals Volkswagen, Rabobank, Kruidvat en Eneco aan de meest innovatieve digitale campagnes. Wij zoeken een gedreven starter die zich wil ontwikkelen binnen een van onze specialistische marketingteams. Je hoeft geen online marketeer te zijn om deel uit te maken van ons team; door deze rol kom je in contact met alle andere media crafts, waardoor jij je kunt verdiepen in meerdere disciplines en de toekomst van AI in marketing.

Bij WPP Media zijn we het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:

• We’re Extraordinary:  We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.

• We’re Open:  We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken - met onze teams, klanten en partners.

• We’re Optimistic:  Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.

Wat ga je doen als Campaign Operations Specialist in Eindhoven?
Wil je graag binnen de online marketingwereld werken, maar weet je nog niet precies waar je passie ligt? Als Campaign Operations Specialist krijg je de unieke kans om alle facetten van online marketing te ontdekken én je eigen carrièrepad te bepalen, met een sterke focus op data en AI.  De eerste twee jaar staan volledig in het teken van jouw groei!

Wat maakt deze startersfunctie zo awesome?

• On-the-job training & Directe Impact:  Geen saaie theorie, maar direct aan de slag in een klantteam! Je duikt in de data, analyseert campagnes, spot trends en zorgt ervoor dat ze optimaal presteren. De eerste 6 maanden werk je fulltime mee in een klantteam, waar je leert hoe AI onze campagnes slimmer en effectiever maakt.

• Ontdek je Talenten & Specialiseer:  Na die 6 maanden kies je een specialisme (Social, Online Video, SEO, SEA, Programmatic, etc.) waar je 50% van je tijd aan besteedt. Zo ontdek je wat je écht leuk vindt en leer je de fijne kneepjes van het vak, altijd met oog voor de rol van AI.

• Leer de Taal van Online Marketing & AI:  CPM's, CPC's, attributie, machine learning... klinkt als abracadabra? Geen probleem! Wij leren je alles wat je moet weten én hoe je deze kennis dagelijks inzet om campagnes te optimaliseren met behulp van geavanceerde tools.

• Jouw Ontwikkeling Staat Centraal:  Veel leren, jezelf ontwikkelen en ontdekken waar jouw passie ligt als online marketeer. Je krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, nieuwe ideeën te testen en te experimenteren, met volop aandacht voor de nieuwste AI-ontwikkelingen. Dit alles binnen een gestructureerd traject van 2 jaar.

• Teamplayer & Spilfun

title: Director, B2B Data Strategy & Revenue Analytics
description:
The Role
At Wpromote, we need someone who can own marketing measurement all the way from click to pipeline to revenue.
This role sits at the intersection of tracking, marketing operations, CRM, and analytics. You’ll make sure campaign data is captured correctly at the source, passed cleanly through our marketing and sales systems, and tied back to pipeline and revenue in a way the business can trust. That means knowing how front-end tracking works, how GTM and site instrumentation should be set up, how marketing automation and CRM systems ingest and sync data, and how to QA the full handoff from campaign to seller to opportunity to closed revenue.
This is not a reporting-only role. We need someone who can diagnose where measurement breaks, fix the root cause, and build the operating discipline to keep it working.
Success in this role looks like:
Marketing activity is reliably tied to pipeline and revenue
Campaign data is structured correctly from the start and remains consistent across systems
Sellers receive the right lead and campaign context
Marketing automation and CRM syncs are clean, documented, and auditable
Attribution disputes are resolved with evidence, not guesswork
Leadership trusts the numbers because the measurement foundation is strong
 
At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.
 
We offer:
 
-Remote-first culture
-Unlimited PTO
-Extended Holiday break (Winter)
-Flexible schedules
-Work from anywhere options*
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching
-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
-Sponsored life insurance
-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
-Annual Class Pass credits and more!
 
The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $140,000 - $160,000 based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above) and an annual performance bonus.
This role has an associated annual target bonus component which is paid out based on a number of factors which include Company performance, department performance, and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed and you must be an active employee in good standing and not on a Performance Improvement Plan to be eligible for the annual bonus.
 
*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles, Chicago, and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
 
Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams
Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant
description:
Apollo .io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo .io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo .io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

At Apollo , Senior Solutions Consultants don't just support deals, they shape them. This role sits at the intersection of revenue, product, and the customer, directly influencing how Apollo wins, retains, and expands its most strategic accounts. As a trusted technical and strategic advisor across the full customer lifecycle, this person drives complex, high-stakes deals forward, accelerates time-to-value, and influences long-term business outcomes for our customers. This person is not only an expert in solution architecture, but they also serve as player-coach who scales the impact of the SC function through mentorship, strategic influence, and repeatable playbooks and tools.
You will partner with AEs and AMs, Sales Leadership, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to architect end-to-end solutions, from discovery through customer onboarding and expansion. You will also help scale the Solution Consulting team by building repeatable playbooks and tools, documenting best practices, and mentoring peers.
What You’ll Do

•
Discovery & Value Selling - Lead technical and business discovery to uncover pain, success metrics, and buying criteria. Align Apollo ’s platform to ROI, operational efficiency, and revenue impact through tailored narratives and demos, presenting confidently to technical and non-technical executive audiences.

•
Sales Partnership - Co-own complex deals with AEs by collaborating on deal strategy with a strong, informed point of view to influence stakeholders, navigate buying committees, and mitigate evaluation risk through deep cross-functional engagement.

•
POC & Trial Execution - Design and run POC-based trials that validate business impact early, identify leading indicator success metrics, and accelerate decision-making. Facilitate the pre-sale to post-sale handoff to ensure smooth onboarding and expansion readiness for our customers.

•
Technical Discovery & Solution Design - Engage technical stakeholders to design scalable, secure integrations. Produce system diagrams, data flows, and architecture recommendations that align with buyer objectives. Leverage REST APIs, CRM/marketing automation, and tools like Zapier or Workato to integrate Apollo into the GTM stack, decreasing customer time-to-value and long-term scalability.

•
Product Strategy - Serve as the voice of the customer, advising on go-to-market solution optimization and surfacing actionable feedback from the field to influence product roadmap priorities, GTM strategy, and how Apollo wins and retains customers.

•
Full-funnel Solution Management & Tooling - Co-create solutions that drive adoption, manage process change, and work closely with Onboarding and Success teams to mitigate post-sale risk and ensure customers achieve measurable value.

•
Mentorship & Enablement - Coach peers on discovery, demos, and technical and solution strategy - while contributing to internal enablement sessions, building playbooks, demo environments, and competitive resources that elevate team performanc

This includes designing and maintaining the server architecture that handles real-world, high-volume interactions and ensures high availability and performance. While we’re focused on server optimization and data management rather than pure research, you’ll be working with some of the most advanced technologies in the cloud and server space.

• Experience in containerized application deployment using Kubernetes and Docker in microservices architectures.

• Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, with a strong understanding of cloud security and compliance standards.

Auditovanie a optimalizácia merania konverzií naprieč kľúčovými reklamnými systémami (Google Ads, Meta a pod.) pre zabezpečenie maximálnej dátovej presnosti a výkonu kampaní.

• Generovanie strategických Insightov:  Identifikácia kľúčových dátových insightov a trendov. Preklad komplexných analytických zistení do jasných, akčných strategických odporúčaní pre optimalizáciu digitálnych stratégií a kampaní klientov.

• Analytické Projektové Vedenie:  Samostatné riadenie a doručovanie komplexných analytických projektov pre klientov, od počiatočnej definície biznisových potrieb až po prezentáciu výsledkov a odporúčaní.

• Optimalizácia Merania a Implementácie:  Návrh a  implementácia pokročilých meracích plánov a udalostí prostredníctvom Google Tag Manager (vrátane server-side taggingu) pre web a aplikácie, zabezpečujúc súlad s legislatívou (napr. Consent Mode v2).

• Spolupráca s Internými Tímami:  Podpora a komunikácia s mediálnymi plánovačmi, stratégmi a klientskymi tímami pri definovaní budúcich stratégií a kampaní. Úzka spoluprácas našimi Data, Reporting & Automation Specialistami.

• Reporting & Vizualizácia:  Prezentácia výsledkov a odporúčaní klientom a interným tímom. Návrh a nastavenie automatizovaných reportov v nástrojoch ako Looker Studio alebo Power BI na tvorbu zrozumiteľných a vizuálne atraktívnych prehľadov.

• Kontinuálne Vzdelávanie a Inovácie:  Aktívne sledovanie trendov, štúdium nových nástrojov a metodík v oblasti digitálnej dátovej analytiky. Prototypovanie nových analytických prístupov. Mentoring a vzdelávanie kolegov v oblastiach digitálnej analytiky.

title: Junior Customer Programs Manager DACH (m/w/d)
description:
Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr - werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit!

Es ist eine aufregende Zeit bei SoSafe! Wir erweitern kontinuierlich unsere Kundenbasis, und das Customer Programs Team ist dafür verantwortlich, die Reise unserer Mid-Market-Kunden von der Onboarding-Phase bis zur Verlängerung zu begleiten - durch Ad-hoc-Anrufe, Webinare und 1-to-Many-Interaktionen.

In dieser Rolle wirst du verschiedene Engagement-Modelle für unsere Kundenbasis entwickeln, um die Produktadaption sicherzustellen und skalierbare Customer-Success-Strategien zu implementieren, die außergewöhnlichen geschäftlichen Mehrwert und herausragende Nutzererlebnisse bieten.

Wir suchen eine/n analytische/n und kundenorientierte/n Teamplayer/in, der/die in der Lage ist, eine neue Strategie umzusetzen, nach dem Prinzip "Test-and-Learn" zu arbeiten und messbare Ergebnisse zu liefern.

Du wirst skalierbare Programme für unsere Kunden entwickeln, verwalten und umsetzen. Diese Programme können u. a. Nutzerschulungen, die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmarketing- und Technik-Teams zur Durchführung von Webinaren, die Automatisierung unserer CS-Prozesse (z. B. Lifecycle-Management, Verlängerungen, Reifegradmodell etc.) sowie die Kuratierung von Inhalten umfassen. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: “What would I do if this patient were my mom?” That question drives everything we do.
But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare-driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

• Experience in pharma, medical device, or diagnostics.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
ABOUT US

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

THE ROLE

As Finance Associate at Encord, you'll own the operational core of our finance function, including: supplier payments, customer invoicing, and month-end reconciliations - ensuring everything runs accurately and on time. You'll partner closely with the wider finance function and cross-functional teams across the business, helping make finance a great partner to the rest of the company. The day-to-day processes are yours to run and improve: where something is manual or unclear, you'll have the real opportunity to make it better. It's a strong fit for someone early in their finance career who takes ownership seriously and wants their work to underpin the teams building tools for multimodal AI.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable, VAT returns and accounts receivable.

- Process employee expense reports and ensure adherence to company policies.

- Oversee client invoicing and manage billing workflows.

- Assist with month-end close procedures, bank reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance.

- Support financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis.

- Collaborate on ad-hoc finance and operational projects as they arise.

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Precision in the core. You take pride in managing the transactional heart of the company. You aren't just processing invoices or reconciling accounts; you view accuracy in bookkeeping and compliance as the critical foundation that allows us to move fast and make informed decisions.

- A builder of systems. You don’t just accept manual processes as status quo. Whether it’s improving expense workflows or refining billing, you look for the "better way" to do things, ensuring our financial systems scale as quickly as our business.

- Collaborative by nature. You recognize that effective finance isn’t a back-office function-it’s a partner to the business. You’re ready to bridge the gap between financial operations and the cross-functional teams building the tools for multimodal AI.

- Ready for high-growth ownership. You are early in your finance career, but you crave responsibility. You want a role where your daily output directly supports our growth, and you’re hungry for the professional development that comes from operating in a fast-paced environment.

 

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

- Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

- 1-2 years of experience in a finance, accounting, or analytical role (tech or startup experience is a plus, but not required).

- Solid foundational knowledge of bookkeeping, accounts payable/receivable, and invoicing.

- Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

- Proficiency in spreadsheet software and financial tools. An understanding of AI-native finance stacks would be advantageous

- Proactive mindset with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, growing environment.

 

WHY ENCORD

- Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup

- Strong in-person culture - most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

- 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

- Company lunches twice a week

- Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: Our Business Development team is at the forefront of the AI ecosystem. We build strategic partnerships with the world’s leading Data and AI platforms, as well as ERP, CRM, and industry-specific vendors. We don’t just extend the Celonis platform; we embed our intelligence layer into the partner stack to power AI-driven transformation, growing ARR and scaling agentic deployments globally.

The Role: You will own the end-to-end partnership lifecycle for our most strategic Data & AI partners. Your mission is to position Celonis as the essential "context layer" for Enterprise AI. You will identify high-impact AI use cases, design joint Agentic solutions, and manage OEM accounts to ensure Celonis is the engine behind their intelligent automation. You will serve as the connective tissue between our partners and the Celonis Applied AI, Engineering, and Product teams.

The work you'll do:

• Architect the AI Ecosystem: Demonstrate how the Process Intelligence Graph provides the context for a partner’s AI and LLM applications.

• Drive AI-First Sales Cycles: Support leadership in driving complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with tier-one AI and software vendors (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft).

• Co-Innovate Joint Solutions: Lead AI Value Workshops and develop business cases focused on the ROI of AI-enriched process automation.

• Drive AI Adoption: Manage the health of signed OEM accounts, identifying new generative and predictive AI use cases to ensure active adoption and platform stickiness.

• Shape the AI Roadmap: Capture partner feedback on AI/ML requirements to inform the Celonis product roadmap and stay ahead of competitive dynamics in the Agentic AI space.

• Validate Technical Feasibility: Collaborate with Applied AI Engineering to validate the integration of LLMs and the deployment of zero-copy data strategies.

What you bring:

• 4-6+ years of experience in Enterprise Software, Business Development, or AI/ML Solution Consulting.

• Proven ability to build business cases for AI-driven transformation and negotiate complex commercial frameworks.

• Strong technical acumen in the AI/Data stack (e.g., understanding of LLMs, Vector Databases, and how Process Intelligence integrates with AI agents).

• Ability to translate complex process data into a compelling AI value proposition for executive-level stakeholders.

• Track record of navigating first-of-their-kind sales cycles in the AI or Data infrastructure space.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
About Lumivero

At Lumivero , we build software that helps researchers, educators, and organizations around the world transform data into meaningful insights. Our engineering teams develop secure, scalable SaaS solutions that support thousands of users globally.
We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, automating manual processes, and building reliable cloud platforms. If you're passionate about Kubernetes, cloud technologies, automation, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

NOTE: This is a Full-Time opportunity (employed through our Employer of Record partner)

This position is intended to be performed from Mexico or another country in Latin America.
About the Team
You'll join a collaborative, globally distributed Technology team responsible for the reliability, scalability, and security of Lumivero 's SaaS platform. Our DevOps engineers partner closely with Software Engineering, Security, and Product teams to build and maintain the infrastructure that enables rapid, reliable software delivery.
This is an opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies while having a direct impact on the platform that powers our products.
What You'll Do
As a DevOps Engineer, you'll help ensure our production platform remains secure, reliable, and highly available while continuously improving how software is built and deployed.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Deploy and manage Kubernetes environments using kOps and Helm.

• Administer AWS infrastructure and supporting cloud services.

• Support Azure environments and related services.

• Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code and Pipelines as Code solutions.

• Automate deployments, Docker image creation, and infrastructure provisioning.

• Design and maintain scalable environments that support our growing SaaS platform.

• Monitor production systems and troubleshoot issues using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.

• Participate in an on-call rotation to support production incidents.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to improve deployment reliability and operational excellence.

• Continuously improve platform automation, security, and operational efficiency.

• Able to participate in On-call rotations

What You'll Bring
Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or similar infrastructure role.

• Experience managing Docker containers and Kubernetes environments.

• Strong Linux administration experience.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Pipelines as Code.

• Experience working with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

• Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or ArgoCD.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Professional working proficiency in English (CEFR B2 or higher). Candidates should be comfortable participating in technical discussions, collaborating in meetings, and reading and writing technical documentation.

• Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and continuous learning mindset.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with:

• Kubernetes and Helm

• Terraform, Packer, or Ansible

• AWS services including EC2, IAM, VPC, ELB, Route53, RDS, and CloudWatch

• Azure services including AKS, RBAC, Virtual Networks, and Application Gateway

• MySQL, SQL Server, or other relational databases

• Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes)

title: Lead CPA - Bill Pay & Tax Practice
description:
We're looking for a CPA who wants to build something - not from scratch, and not alone, but with the freedom to shape a practice the way it should be shaped.
Our firm provides integrated financial care to physician families across California and several other U.S. states. We currently serve hundreds of households, and we're adding to the ways we serve them.
Today, our clients' tax and bookkeeping needs are served through external partner firms we've worked with for years. That partnership has helped us get to where we are, and it will continue. At the same time, we see meaningful gaps we'd like to fill ourselves - starting with bill pay and straightforward tax preparation. We'd like you to lead that work.
WHAT YOU'D BE BUILDING
A premium, integrated practice that complements the financial planning our clients already receive from us. You'd start with a built-in client base, an established brand, and something most CPAs building a practice never get: a global team of seasoned client service associates who handle first contact and administrative support. That means your time goes to the craft and the client conversations, not to sales, marketing, recruiting, legal, nor IT.
The practice is designed to evolve with our clients' needs over time, and you'll have a meaningful voice in how it grows.
WHAT YOU'D DO

• Provide bill pay services for elders and high-net-worth client families

• Prepare straightforward personal tax returns, primarily for W-2 households

• Shape how the practice grows, including how we manage the natural seasonality of tax work

• Collaborate with other team leaders to design repeatable systems that fit within our existing framework. Fitting in with our processes is essential.

YOU'LL ALSO BRING YOUR EXPERTISE TO

• Helping clients keep their financial records organized and decision-ready

• Guiding clients through entity-related questions that come up in their financial lives

• Bringing a tax-informed perspective into our team's planning conversations

• Being a trusted, knowledgeable resource for clients on the financial details that matter to them

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Licensed CPA in good standing

• Meaningful experience in tax preparation, with some exposure to bookkeeping

• Drawn to the idea of designing a practice rather than inheriting one

• A clear, warm communicator who genuinely enjoys client relationships

• Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones

• Interested in the physician niche, or excited to learn it deeply

HOW WE WORK
We've been a fully distributed company since 2013, and over the years we've built a global team of seasoned client service associates who handle first contact and administrative support for every advisor, including you. Our shared priority is to protect your time for online conversations with clients.
Compensation is negotiable and tailored to the right person. We're open to W-2 with bonus or 1099, depending on what fits your situation and goals.
